name: Harlyn Sands Holiday Park
stayType: Family holiday park with caravans and pitches
accommodation: Holiday caravans in a range of sizes (pet-friendly and pet-free options) and 80 grass pitches for tents and touring caravans
dogs: Listed as dog friendly by Visit Cornwall, with pet-friendly caravans
beachAccess: About 300 yards from a sandy beach; Constantine Bay and Booby's Bay a short walk away
confirmedFeatures: Clubhouse with entertainment, restaurant, bars, kids club, games room, play area, swimming pool, shop, laundry
overview: A family holiday park on Lighthouse Road near Trevose Head, overlooking Harlyn Bay and a short walk from Constantine Bay and Booby's Bay. It offers holiday caravans and around 80 grass pitches for tents and tourers. On-site facilities include a pool, clubhouse, shop and kids club.
surfTripFit: Booby's Bay and Constantine Bay are within walking distance, with Harlyn close by as a sheltered alternative.
